titulo: Trump meets Zelenskyy, Netanyahu as wars test U.S. diplomacy
cuerpo: U.S. President Donald Trump met separately with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East continue to test U.S. diplomacy. Zelenskyy hopes to revive diplomatic efforts with Russia, while Trump's talks with Netanyahu come amid differences over Iran.
